name: Bright
desc: A charismatic billionaire tech founder in his forties giving a keynote speech. Warm, bright, polished male voice, radio-host smooth with a big trustworthy smile you can hear, persuasive and friendly, with something cold just underneath. American accent. Clear studio recording.
text: Hi, everyone. I'm Sterling Bright. Today, BrightSide is giving every single person on Earth a free BrightCap. Because the future should be free. Smile!
